description: Validate an agent locally: typecheck, bundle and import index.ts, derive the manifest, and check the step graph. Needs no Sapiom account or service call to validate; author-written top-level side effects still run when the definition is imported. Returns the agent name, step count, the manifest (which contains the full step graph for visualization), and any warnings — graph warnings, plus one per project file (AGENTS.md, the sapiom-agent-authoring skill) whose platform-rules stamp differs from the copy the Sapiom API currently serves, from a best-effort anonymous read of that endpoint's headers (skipped when the project carries no stamp, silent when unreachable).

dir.description: Project directory (defaults to the current working directory).

name: sapiom_dev_agents_check
